senses.definition: A person who cares for one or more babies or children for a short period of time in place of their legal guardians.
examples: My neighbor is sometimes a babysitter for other mothers’ children.

senses.definition: (derogatory) A person who has to watch or attend to anything or anyone unnecessarily closely; a coddler or handholder.

quotes.text: He said he did not want to be on tenterhooks worrying about us and having to act as a babysitter for grown men.
